description_en: Removes tags from resources and then deletes the tags
description_zh: 为指定的一个或多个资源统一解绑并删除标签
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type ALIYUN::WAF::DEFENSERESOURCE --resource-id demo.xxxxaliyundoc.com-waf --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en:
The region in which the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the resource. Set the value to ALIYUN::WAF::DEFENSERESOURCE
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from the specified resource groups or members. Valid values:

false (default)

true
parameters.help_zh:
是否解绑指定资源组或资源目录成员的全部标签。取值：
false（默认值）：否
true：是
parameters.name: all

parameters.help_en: The resource IDs. You can specify up to 50 resource IDs
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The tag keys. You can specify up to 20 tag keys
parameters.help_zh: 标签键列表，最多20个子项
parameters.name: tag_key
